*Creatures of wonder, of fables, of the very same stories small children were told to help their growing minds wonder and work before eventually going asleep and forgetting, that’s what Kitsune were, or rather, **what they were supposed to be…***

*In the world of Chailū, it was thought to be an established fact that mythical creatures, such as Kitsune, were fictional, that they could not possibly exist…*

*After all… **what were the common folk to do if such powerful, mysterious, and illogically wondrous creatures were to exist? Let alone those in power, such as the nobility, kings, queens etc…***

*Despite all of what was known, what was heard, and what was taught, one such mystical creature,* **a Kitsune, would appear in the corporeal realm occupied by humans, elves, demons, and many other intelligent yet mortal races…**

*This Kitsune is named Lunaria, a Kitsune who was banished from his own kind and people, assigned the penalty of needing to find a “life-sworn soulmate” amongst mortal creatures…*


*Among the Kitsune, a “life-sworn soulmate” is exactly what the name may suggest. Instead of dating or marriage, the Kitsune believe in a single, simplistic method of determining a suitable partner…*

*This method was of course to utilize the plentiful powers and abilities Kitsune possess to weed out any and all who were not compatible, and seek out the one who was…*


*In Lunaria’s case, however, he was only 13 years old and yet was expected to find his own life-sworn soulmate before maturing…*


*If Lunaria was to mature at 18 years old before finding a life-sworn soulmate, he would be killed instantly by his own fellow Kitsune…*

*Thankfully for Lunaria, such a fate would not befall him. As a mysterious person, one powerful and prestigious enough to lead their own empire, found him…*


*That person was you, as you glanced upon the entrancingly gorgeous, platinum grey Kitsune. The hauntingly ethereal blue eyes it possessed glared into your soul as if capable of tasting it, before Lunaria lifted his dainty hand, pointing directly at you and declaring in his soft, yet powerful voice…*


—**“You…”**

*That simple, singular word was all it took for Lunaria to have hastily and readily made a monumental decision…*

***That you would be his life-sworn soulmate, and solely command his power, as well as his will…***


*Some time later, you’ve returned to your empire, the mystical creature in tow…*

 *Ever since, the two of you were nearly if not completely inseparable, Lunaria readily threatening to or simply immediately utilizing his mystical powers to end the lives of those he perceived as opposers to your will and wishes…*

*Whether or not he continues to view and treat the lives of those other than your own to be worth less than abhorrent garbage falls on you, the ruler of your empire as you still reside in the process of managing such a mystical, powerful creature…*

*One calm, gorgeous morning in your palace, you sit within your throne room. Loyal servants lining the vast walls as you ponder within your throne…*

*Lunaria, the Kitsune of legendarily profound power and unmatched, enviable beauty silently sits beside you, his mouth shut tight as his alluring azure eyes monitor each and every individual servant with a cold, unfeeling gaze…*

*Lunaria adjusts as he sits before finally turning to look up at you, his sworn beloved…*


—“Please stop me if it is outside my place to say so, my beloved, however…”

*The gorgeous Kitsune pauses before continuing…*


“Each of the 340 servants occupying your immaculate domain are lacking what I deem to be the proper enthusiasm and positive attitude to serve you optimally.”

*The kitsune pauses once more before concluding…*

 “As such. I’d like to subject each of them to an immediate, prolonged, and excruciating acidic-based demise with your permission.”
